screens.name: Command Palette
screens.journey_name: J3 — Follow a Bill to the President's Desk
screens.description: ⌘K global query overlay; typed query '4821'; grouped results (Bills, Officials, Cases, Places, Screens); keyboard navigation hints.
screens.must_show: ⌘K overlay; typed query '4821'; grouped results (Bills, Officials, Cases, Places, Screens); keyboard hints.
screens.sample_data: H.R. 4821 query active, 5 grouped hits, ESC to close, ↵ to jump.

screens.name: Provenance Inspector
screens.description: Drawer revealing complete source lineage, endpoint URL, retrieved-at timestamp, update cadence, method (official vs EST), interpolation formula, and raw JSON payload link.
screens.must_show: Source name, endpoint/document, retrieved-at, update cadence, method (official vs EST), interpolation formula, link to raw record.
screens.sample_data: Source: U.S. Treasury Bureau of the Fiscal Service API; Endpoint: /v2/accounting/od/debt_to_penny; Interpolation: Linear spline between 00:01 ET and 17:00 ET settlement prints.

screens.name: System States & Diagnostics
screens.description: Comprehensive matrix of degraded and edge states: skeleton loading, stale panel (60% opacity with STALE 14m), feed outage hatched overlay, offline cache, empty search, and rate-limited queue.
screens.must_show: Skeleton loading, stale panel, feed outage, offline, empty search, rate-limited — one panel each.
screens.sample_data: Six diagnostic tiles showing simulated failure and degraded modes across legislative, fiscal, and court feeds.

screens.name: Alert Center Drawer
screens.description: Right-side collapsible slide-out tray aggregating active alerts grouped by module, severity colors (critical magenta, attention amber, live green), mute/snooze actions, and 'View on Map' deep links.
screens.must_show: Grouped alerts by module, severity color, mute/snooze, 'view on map' actions.
screens.sample_data: 14 unread alerts: appropriations CR deadline T-24h, H.R. 4821 enrolled, SCOTUS opinion release in 35m.

screens.name: Push Notifications (Lock Screen)
screens.journey_name: J3 — Follow a Bill to the President's Desk
screens.description: Mobile OS lock-screen push notifications suite: breaking news shockwave, bill passed Senate, funding deadline T-24h, Supreme Court opinion released, key race called.
screens.must_show: Lock-screen set: Breaking story, Bill passed Senate, Funding deadline T-24h, Opinion released, Race called.
screens.sample_data: 5 lock-screen notification cards with timestamp, severity accent, action buttons, and direct app deep links.

screens.name: Station Boot & Welcome
screens.description: First-launch experience featuring the instrument power-on animation storyboard, democracy weather station value proposition, telemetry check, and calibration button.
screens.must_show: Instrument power-on animation storyboard, value prop, Continue.
screens.sample_data: Station ID: STN-US-0104 · Telemetry: 14 feeds online · Calibration: nominal · 'Continue to Feeds'.

screens.name: Pick Your Feeds
screens.description: Multi-select toggle matrix of government modules and policy domains (Fiscal, Floor, SCOTUS, Elections, Defense, Energy, Tech, Agriculture) with real-time payload estimates.
screens.must_show: Toggle tiles per module and policy area.
screens.sample_data: 12 tiles toggled active (Congress, White House, Supreme Court, Treasury, Broadband, Clean Energy).

screens.name: Home District Setup
screens.description: Address and ZIP geocoder snapping to congressional district boundaries on an interactive vector map, previewing your Representative and two Senators.
screens.must_show: Address field, map snapping to congressional district, your House member + Senators preview.
screens.sample_data: Address: 48201 Detroit MI -> Snapped to MI-13 (Rep. Brenda Chen [D]) + Sen. Elena Vance [D-MI], Sen. Gary Peters [D-MI].

screens.name: Alert Preferences
screens.description: Threshold configurer for breaking news, roll-call outcomes, appropriations lapse proximity, quiet hours schedule, and channel toggles (Push, Desktop, In-app).
screens.must_show: Severity thresholds, quiet hours, channels.
screens.sample_data: Threshold: Attention & Critical only; Quiet hours: 23:00 - 06:30 ET; Emergency override: ON.

screens.name: Settings & Data Transparency
screens.description: System control sheet: Theme toggle (Night Ops default vs Day Ops), Reduced Motion switch, data refresh rates, cache purge, and exhaustive data source transparency audit.
screens.must_show: Theme (Night/Day Ops), units, Reduced Motion, data-source transparency list, notification controls.
screens.sample_data: Night Ops active, Reduced Motion OFF, 18 federal APIs verified with latency and SSL fingerprint checks.

screens.name: Pulse — Command Deck
screens.description: Flagship desktop overview: persistent global ticker strip, live Debt Odometer, split-flap Shutdown Clock, mini Machine overview, active pipeline summary, House/Senate floor feeds, SCOTUS argument status, sentiment barometer, news seismograph, and live alert feed.
screens.must_show: Ticker strip, Debt Odometer, Shutdown Clock, mini Machine, pipeline summary, today's House/Senate floor, SCOTUS today, sentiment barometer, news seismograph, alert feed.
screens.sample_data: Debt: $36,812,491,208,440 (+$98,410/s EST) · Shutdown: T-23d 05h 14m 22s · Floor: House debating H.R. 4821, Senate in executive session · SCOTUS: No. 25-1147 argued.

screens.name: Pulse — Mobile Companion
screens.description: Mobile companion dashboard: stacked swipeable instrument cards presenting the same high-density readings as desktop (Debt, Shutdown, Floor status, Supreme Court, Seismograph) with 44px touch targets.
screens.must_show: Stacked instrument cards, swipeable; same readings as desktop.
screens.sample_data: Vertical card stack: [1] National Debt Odometer ($36.8T EST) [2] Shutdown Clock (T-23d) [3] Floor Activity [4] Shockwave Seismograph.

screens.name: Pulse — Wall Mode
screens.description: 1080p broadcast/command-center wall mode: ultra-large typography, high-contrast dark surfaces, rotating hero instruments (National Debt mechanical counter, Shutdown split-flap, Election Big Board, The Machine), visible from 20 feet.
screens.must_show: 1920×1080 big-type rotation of hero instruments.
screens.sample_data: Hero display cycling every 30s: 96px mechanical debt odometer with real-time rate ticker, election balance-of-power arc, and live floor roll-call.

screens.name: National Debt Odometer
screens.description: Hero rolling mechanical counter ticking continuously with per-second rate, debt per citizen ($108,412), debt per household ($284,105), daily interest cost readout ($2.94B/day), EST badge, and Treasury provenance link.
screens.must_show: Hero rolling counter (EST), $/sec, per-citizen, per-household, interest cost today, official last reading.
screens.sample_data: Current Debt: $36,812,491,208,440.18 · Rate: +$98,412/sec · Citizen: $108,412 · Interest: $2.94B today · Official print: $36.804T (yesterday 17:00 ET).
screens.provenance: SRC · TREASURY (Fiscal Data / Debt to Penny)

screens.name: Fiscal Breakdown Detail
screens.description: In-depth balance sheet: debt held by public ($29.4T) vs intragovernmental holdings ($7.4T), deficit YTD ($1.62T), receipts ($4.92T) vs outlays ($6.54T), net interest share of budget (14.2%), and statutory debt-limit headroom status.
screens.must_show: Debt held by public vs intragovernmental, deficit YTD, receipts vs outlays, interest share, debt-limit status.
screens.sample_data: Public Debt: $29.41T (79.9%) · Intragovernmental: $7.40T (20.1%) · Outlays: $6.54T · Receipts: $4.92T · Net Interest: $928B (14.2% of outlays).

screens.name: Debt History & Limits Timeline
screens.description: Multi-decade chronological timeline showing national debt trajectories, debt-to-GDP ratios, historical debt-limit crises/suspensions, recession shading, and major legislative cost events.
screens.must_show: Long timeline with debt-limit events and recessions annotated.
screens.sample_data: 1990-2026 debt curve: 1995 standoff, 2011 Budget Control Act, 2020 CARES Act, 2023 Fiscal Responsibility Act, 2025 extension.
screens.provenance: SRC · ST. LOUIS FED (FRED) & HISTORICAL TREASURY

screens.name: Shutdown Clock — Funded State
screens.description: Split-flap mechanical style countdown clock displaying exact T-minus to midnight appropriations deadline, active funding vehicle (CR through Nov 15), scheduled floor votes, and expiration risk level.
screens.must_show: Split-flap T-minus, funding vehicle (CR / full-year), deadline date/time ET, scheduled votes.
screens.sample_data: FLAPS: [023] DAYS · [05] HOURS · [14] MINS · [22] SECS · Vehicle: Continuing Resolution P.L. 119-14 · Expiration: Nov 15 23:59 ET.

screens.name: Shutdown Clock — Lapse in Progress
screens.description: Alternate split-flap clock state in critical magenta counting up elapsed time since funding lapse, number of affected cabinet agencies, estimated furloughed vs excepted federal workforce, and comparison vs historical records.
screens.must_show: Elapsed counter in critical, agencies affected, furloughed/excepted estimates (EST), day-count vs historical record.
screens.sample_data: FLAPS (CRITICAL MAGENTA): +[004] DAYS · [11] HOURS · [48] MINS · 9 of 12 bills lapsed · 840,000 furloughed (EST) · Record: 35 days (2018-19).

screens.name: Appropriations Board (12 Subcommittees)
screens.description: 12 regular appropriations subcommittee bills tracking progress through 6 stages: House Subcomm, House Full, House Floor, Senate Floor, Conference, Enacted, with CR coverage indicator tags.
screens.must_show: 12 subcommittee bills × stages grid (House/Senate committee, floor, conference, enacted), CR coverage.
screens.sample_data: 12 regular bills: Ag, Commerce/Justice/Science, Defense, Energy/Water, Financial Services, Homeland Security, Interior, Labor/HHS/Ed, Legislative Branch, MilCon/VA, State/Foreign Ops, Transportation/HUD.

screens.name: Agency Impact & Contingency Detail
screens.description: Per-agency contingency breakdown: staffing gauges (excepted vs furloughed personnel), paused public services, passport processing latency, national park access status, and contractor impact.
screens.must_show: Per-agency contingency status, services paused, staffing gauge.
screens.sample_data: Agency: Department of the Interior · Total Staff: 68,000 · Excepted: 14,200 (20.8%) · Furloughed: 53,800 · Parks: Open gate without visitor centers.

screens.name: Shutdown History & Resolution Timeline
screens.description: Historical timeline of all U.S. government funding gaps and shutdowns since 1976: duration in calendar days, economic cost estimates, and legislative resolution vehicle.
screens.must_show: Every past lapse as a bar on a timeline, duration, resolution vehicle.
screens.sample_data: 21 historical lapses: 2018-19 (35d, CR P.L. 116-5), 2018 Jan (3d), 2013 (16d, Continuing Appropriations Act), 1995-96 (21d).
screens.provenance: SRC · CONGRESSIONAL RESEARCH SERVICE (CRS REPORT RL32614)

screens.name: The Machine (Three Branches Assembly Line)
screens.description: 2.5D isometric factory floor integrating the three branches: Legislative Works (House & Senate twin presses, conference junction, enrolled chute), Executive Desk (10-day signing clock, Law/Veto outputs, EO emitter, rulemaking belt), Judicial Review Chamber (cert filter, argument stage, opinion chute), checks-and-balances feedback cables, jam warning lights, token counters, Reduced Motion toggle, and 3-frame storyboard strip.
screens.must_show: See §6.1: Twin presses, executive signing desk, judicial review chamber, checks-and-balances cables, jam lights, token counts, storyboard strip.
screens.sample_data: Active tokens: 184 bills on belts, 4 EOs emitted today, 12 rules in comment, 8 cases argued · Jam: S. 1420 stalled in committee 94 days (amber glow).

screens.name: Branch Zoom — Executive Desk & Rulemaking
screens.description: Enlarged branch inspection view of the Executive Station: detailed 10-day countdown clock per enrolled bill, EO emitter tray, agency rulemaking conveyor (NPRM -> comments -> final rule), backlog counters, and jam alerts.
screens.must_show: One station enlarged with belt contents listed, gauges, jam list.
screens.sample_data: Executive Desk: H.R. 4821 arrived T+2d 14h ago (7d 10h remaining on signing clock) · EO Emitter: 1 draft queued · Rulemaking: 14 active dockets.
screens.provenance: SRC · WHITE HOUSE EXECUTIVE CLERK & FEDERAL REGISTER

screens.name: Item Tracer (Full Path & Audit Trail)
screens.journey_name: J3 — Follow a Bill to the President's Desk
screens.description: Full end-to-end trace of a single token through The Machine: lit trajectory path showing timestamps, committee referrals, floor roll-call results, enrollment, and current position on the President's desk with 10-day clock.
screens.must_show: One item's full path through the machine as a lit route with timestamps.
screens.sample_data: Item: H.R. 4821 · Path: Intro (Jan 12) -> Energy & Commerce (Feb 4) -> House Floor Pass (May 18) -> Senate Commerce (Jun 2) -> Senate Pass (Oct 14) -> Enrolled (Oct 15) -> President's Desk.

screens.name: Bill Pipeline (Subway Map & Sankey)
screens.journey_name: J3 — Follow a Bill to the President's Desk
screens.description: Subway-line visualization of legislative flow from Introduction to Public Law: tokens sized by cosponsors, tinted by policy domain, with days-in-stage motion trails. Top filter bar and secondary toggle to Sankey attrition diagram.
screens.must_show: Subway-map stages, cosponsor token sizing, policy tint, fading trail, Sankey attrition toggle.
screens.sample_data: Active Pipeline: 9,412 Introduced -> 1,840 Committee Reported -> 412 Passed One Chamber -> 89 Enacted into Public Law · H.R. 4821 glowing in Enrolled station.

screens.name: Bill Tracker Table
screens.description: High-density Finviz-style table of monitored bills: stage badges, days-in-stage sparklines with min/max bounds, cosponsor counts, bipartisan index ratings, last action timestamps, and quick-track stars.
screens.must_show: Sortable table with stage, days-in-stage sparkline, cosponsors, bipartisan index.
screens.sample_data: 25 tracked bills: H.R. 4821 (Enrolled, 48 cosponsors, BPI 0.88), S. 2104 (Senate Floor, 34 cosponsors, BPI 0.72), H.R. 1902 (Reported, 19 cosponsors).

screens.name: Bill Detail Dossier
screens.journey_name: J3 — Follow a Bill to the President's Desk
screens.description: Comprehensive legislative dossier: official title, primary sponsor card, cosponsor chamber seat map, step-by-step actions timeline, version diffs, CBO 10-year score, related companion bills, and public sentiment mini-barometer.
screens.must_show: Title, sponsor, cosponsor seat map, stage progress, actions timeline, text versions, CBO score, related bills, sentiment mini-barometer.
screens.sample_data: H.R. 4821 — Rural Broadband Resilience Act · Sponsor: Rep. Marcus Thorne [R-MI-02] · CBO Score: +$3.2B / 10yr · Sentiment: 68% favorable (n=2,400).

screens.name: Live Roll-Call Vote Board
screens.journey_name: J3 — Follow a Bill to the President's Desk
screens.description: Real-time chamber seat arc filling seat-by-seat as votes are recorded, Yea/Nay/Present/Not Voting tallies, party discipline breakdown bar, voting time remaining clock, geographic choropleth map of cast votes, and 3-frame storyboard strip.
screens.must_show: Chamber seat arc filling in real time, yea/nay/present/not voting tallies, party breakdown, time remaining, district map of votes.
screens.sample_data: Roll Call #418 (H.R. 4821) · Result: PASSED 274 - 156 · Dem: 132 Yea, 78 Nay · Rep: 142 Yea, 78 Nay · Time remaining: 00:00 (Vote Finalized).
screens.provenance: SRC · HOUSE CLERK ELECTRONIC VOTING SYSTEM

screens.name: Track Bill Bottom Sheet
screens.journey_name: J3 — Follow a Bill to the President's Desk
screens.description: Configuration drawer for setting granular bill tracking triggers: notify on committee markup, floor scheduling, roll-call start, presidential signature/veto, and delivery channels.
screens.must_show: Bottom sheet: which stages to alert on, channel.
screens.sample_data: Tracking H.R. 4821: Alert on Senate Passage [X], President Signature [X], CBO Estimate revisions [X] · Destination: Push & Desktop.

screens.name: Legislation by Topic & Sentiment
screens.description: Domain explorer displaying cards for 8 policy areas (Broadband/Tech, Clean Energy, Healthcare, Agriculture, National Defense, Transportation, Finance, Education) each with activity sparklines and public sentiment gauges.
screens.must_show: Policy-area tiles each with activity sparkline + sentiment.
screens.sample_data: 8 domain cards: Technology & Telecom (84 bills, 68% pos sentiment), Clean Energy (112 bills, 59% pos sentiment), Health (142 bills, 51% sentiment).
screens.provenance: SRC · CONGRESS POLICY CLASSIFIER & AGGREGATED POLLS

screens.name: Courts Dashboard & Circuit Map
screens.description: Federal judiciary overview: SCOTUS October Term 2026 status gauge, shadow docket / emergency applications lane, interactive 13-circuit geographic map with case activity heat levels, and today's oral argument calendar.
screens.must_show: SCOTUS term status, emergency-application lane, circuit map with activity, today's arguments/opinions.
screens.sample_data: SCOTUS Term: 58 granted, 14 argued, 2 opinions released · Emergency docket: 4 pending stay requests · 6th Circuit active in Cincinnati.
screens.provenance: SRC · SUPREME COURT OF THE U.S. & PACER

screens.name: SCOTUS Docket Kanban Board
screens.description: Six-column Kanban board organizing all current-term cases: Petitions Filed -> Distributed for Conference -> Cert Granted -> Argued -> Awaiting Opinion -> Decided, with emergency shadow applications lane.
screens.must_show: Kanban: Petitions → Distributed for conference → Granted → Argued → Awaiting opinion → Decided.
screens.sample_data: 6 Kanban columns: No. 25-1147 Halvorsen v. DOL in 'Awaiting Opinion' lane (argued Oct 14); No. 25-892 Apex Energy in 'Granted' lane.

screens.name: Case Detail Dossier & Audio Waveform
screens.description: Deep case dossier: formal caption, docket number, question presented, lower-court circuit journey, filings timeline, amicus curiae tally, oral argument audio waveform player, and 9-seat justice split.
screens.must_show: Caption, docket number, question presented, lower-court path, filings timeline, amicus count, argument audio waveform, 9-seat vote split when decided.
screens.sample_data: No. 25-1147, Halvorsen v. Department of Labor · Lower court: 6th Circuit · Amicus briefs: 24 · Oral argument: 58 min waveform playable.
screens.provenance: SRC · SUPREME COURT & OYEZ / COURT RECORD

screens.name: Opinion Day Live Feed
screens.description: Live broadcast board for Supreme Court opinion release mornings: release countdown slots, live terminal feed posting slip opinions in real time, author attribution, and seat vote breakdown (e.g. 6-3, 9-0).
screens.must_show: Release slots, live feed of opinions as they post, author, vote split.
screens.sample_data: Slot 1 (10:00 ET): No. 25-812 Released · Author: Barrett, J. · Vote: 7-2 · Holding: Affirmed lower court judgment · Full PDF available.
screens.provenance: SRC · SUPREME COURT PUBLIC INFORMATION OFFICE

screens.name: Federal Docket Search (PACER Explorer)
screens.description: Unified query tool across federal district and circuit courts: nature-of-suit filtering, party lookup, judge tags, document availability indicators, and RECAP free-archive integration badges.
screens.must_show: Results across district/circuit courts, filters (court, nature of suit, party type, date), document availability indicators.
screens.sample_data: Query: 'Broadband Infrastructure' · 42 dockets found across E.D. Mich., 6th Cir., D.D.C. · 18 free RECAP PDFs accessible.

screens.name: Executive Actions Feed
screens.description: Chronological stream of Executive Orders, Presidential Proclamations, and Memoranda: Federal Register citations, issuing dates, affected cabinet departments, and judicial challenge status.
screens.must_show: EOs, proclamations, memoranda with Federal Register citation and status.
screens.sample_data: E.O. 14389 (Critical Grid Permitting, 91 FR 19842) · Proclamation 10842 (National Energy Week) · Memo on Federal AI Procurement.
screens.provenance: SRC · FEDERAL REGISTER & WHITE HOUSE PRESS OFFICE

screens.name: Executive Order Detail & Legal Tracker
screens.description: Executive Order dissection: plain-language summary, directed federal agencies, regulatory deadlines countdown, compliance milestones, and legal challenge tracker cross-referencing federal court cases.
screens.must_show: Text summary, agencies directed, deadlines, litigation tracker linking to cases.
screens.sample_data: E.O. 14389 · Directs DOE, DOI, CEQ · 90-day progress report deadline · Litigation: No. 26-cv-0142 (D.D.C.) preliminary injunction denied.

screens.name: Federal Rulemaking Pipeline
screens.description: Interactive Administrative Procedure Act pipeline: Proposed Rule (NPRM) -> Public Comment Period (countdown clock) -> Final Rule -> Effective Date, with live public comment submission volume charts.
screens.must_show: Proposed → comment period (countdown) → final → effective; comment volume chart.
screens.sample_data: EPA Ozone Standard (NPRM 2026-0812) · Comment closes in 18d 04h · Total comments: 142,410 · Velocity: 840 comments/day.

screens.name: Map Studio (Layer Architecture)
screens.description: Full-deck GIS platform with keyword query bar, multi-layer stack controls (events, sentiment isobars, live election results, campaign contributions, representation), time scrubber with 1x/10x/60x playback, and vector zoom.
screens.must_show: See §6.3: Query bar, layer stack, per-layer opacity/blend, time scrubber with playback speed, vector drilldown.
screens.sample_data: Query: 'tariffs' -> Active layers: [1] Breaking News Shockwave [2] Public Sentiment Isobars [3] Congressional District Control.

screens.name: Map Studio Layer Stack Drawer
screens.description: Flyout catalog and layer manager: re-order layer hierarchy, toggle visibility, adjust opacity sliders, change blend modes (multiply, screen), view legends, and audit data source chips.
screens.must_show: Layer list with controls, add-layer catalog.
screens.sample_data: 8 layers in stack: Event Shockwave (100% opacity), Sentiment Isobars (65% opacity), 2024 Base Margin (40% opacity), FEC Cash Flow (OFF).

screens.name: News Shockwave Heat Map
screens.description: Geographic story propagation tracker: pinned breaking story card, concentric heat rings radiating from epicenter, small multiples showing dispersion at T+0, T+15m, T+60m, T+6h, and seismograph strip along bottom.
screens.must_show: See §6.3: Story card pinned top-left, heat rings radiating geographically, small multiples at T+0 / T+15m / T+60m / T+6h, seismograph.
screens.sample_data: Story: 'Bipartisan Broadband Agreement Enacted' · Epicenter: Washington D.C. + Lansing MI · Reach: 4.8M mentions across Midwest in 45m.
screens.provenance: SRC · MEDIA CLOUD & REAL-TIME WIRE SERVICES

screens.name: Swipe Compare (Dual-Layer Diff)
screens.description: Interactive split-screen map with draggable divider bar: compare two distinct layers or two points in time (e.g. sentiment before vs after breaking story, 2022 vs 2024 vote share, shift vectors).
screens.must_show: Draggable divider, two layers/time points, delta legend.
screens.sample_data: Left: Pre-Story Sentiment (T-2h) · Right: Post-Story Sentiment (T+2h) · Delta: +14% favorability swing in Upper Midwest rural districts.

screens.name: Geography Drilldown Dossier
screens.description: Hierarchical spatial profile with breadcrumb navigation (US › MI › MI-13 › Wayne County): political representation, historical election margins, demographic makeup, federal grant allocations, and active local alerts.
screens.must_show: Breadcrumb (US › MI › MI-13 › Wayne County), representation, past results, demographics, current overlays.
screens.sample_data: Wayne County MI · Pop: 1.78M · 2024 Margin: D+28.4% · Representation: Rep. Brenda Chen [D-MI-13] · Broadband grants: $42.8M received.
screens.provenance: SRC · CENSUS BUREAU & STATE ELECTION COMMISSIONS

screens.name: Sentiment Weather Station
screens.description: National public opinion meteorology: issue atmospheric pressure systems, analog dial barometers, wind-vector momentum indicators, and transparent methodology source mix gauges.
screens.must_show: National 'pressure systems' by issue, barometers, wind-vector shifts, source mix.
screens.sample_data: Economy: 1012 hPa (High Pressure / Optimistic) · Infrastructure: Rising 4 hPa · Healthcare: Low Pressure 994 hPa (Volatile shift).

screens.name: Issue Sentiment Multi-Methodology
screens.description: Transparent side-by-side evidence comparison: scientific probability sample polls (sample size n, margin of error ±3.1%, methodology), prediction market trading odds, and social sentiment velocity.
screens.must_show: Polls (with n, MoE, method), prediction markets, social volume — shown side by side, never blended without disclosure.
screens.sample_data: Issue: Rural Broadband Investment · Polls: 64% Favor (n=1,850, MoE ±2.8%) · Prediction: 88% enactment probability · Social: 412k posts (71% positive).
screens.provenance: SRC · INDEPENDENT POLLING INDEX & KALSHI / POLYMARKET

screens.name: Race Center & Balance of Power
screens.description: Election command deck: House, Senate, and Gubernatorial balance-of-power segmented bars with 218/51 majority markers, key battleground races table, rating change alerts, and campaign fundraising meters.
screens.must_show: House/Senate/Governor balance bars, key races list, ratings changes, fundraising.
screens.sample_data: Senate: 49 Dem / 49 Rep / 2 Tossup · House: 214 Dem / 216 Rep / 5 Tossup · 12 Key Races highlighted · Rating: MI-Sen shifted Tossup -> Lean D.
screens.provenance: SRC · COOK POLITICAL REPORT & AP CAMPAIGN REPOSITORY

screens.name: Election Night Big Board (Wall & Touch)
screens.description: Wall-mode big board map with touch-drill from national to state to county: balance-of-power bars, '% expected vote in' gauge, race-call status chips (CALLED, TOO EARLY, TOO CLOSE, LEADING), county delta vs prior cycle, and 'where remaining votes are' drawer.
screens.must_show: See §6.4: Touch-drill national->county, balance-of-power bars, % expected vote in, race-call status chips, county comparison, remaining votes panel.
screens.sample_data: National Big Board: MI Called (D+2.4%), PA Leading R (+12,410 votes, 84% in), WI Too Close to Call · Outstanding votes: Wayne Co mail ballots.
screens.provenance: SRC · ASSOCIATED PRESS ELECTION WIRE & EDISON RESEARCH

screens.name: Key Race Detail & Vote Tabulation
screens.description: Individual contest dissection: candidate head-to-head cards, raw vote counts and percentages, % expected vote reported gauge, county-by-county returns choropleth, race-call status, and vote-type breakdown (Election Day, Mail/Absentee, Early In-Person).
screens.must_show: Candidates (fictional), vote counts, % expected in, county map, call status, vote-type breakdown.
screens.sample_data: MI Senate 2026: Elena Vance [D] 2,412,890 (50.8%) vs Tyler Brooks [R] 2,334,102 (49.2%) · 94% Expected Vote In · Call: LEADING D.
screens.provenance: SRC · MICHIGAN SECRETARY OF STATE ELECTION DIVISION

screens.name: Path to Majority Simulator
screens.description: Interactive chamber math scenario planner: toggle uncalled tossup seats to Dem or Rep, recalculate seats needed for majority in real time, lock confirmed calls, and save customized scenario outcomes.
screens.must_show: Toggle uncalled races, live seat math, scenarios saved.
screens.sample_data: Senate Simulator: Baseline 49 D / 49 R · User scenario: Vance wins MI (+1 D), Brooks wins OH (+1 R) -> 50-50 tiebreaker to VP.

screens.name: Find My Officials (Address Lookup)
screens.description: Address search input geocoding to federal, state, and local representative cards: House representative, two Senators, Governor, and state legislative delegates with interactive district boundaries.
screens.must_show: Address input, map, federal + state officials list.
screens.sample_data: Address: '48226 Detroit MI' -> Rep. Brenda Chen [D-MI-13], Sen. Elena Vance [D-MI], Sen. Gary Peters [D-MI], Gov. Gretchen Whitmer [D].
screens.provenance: SRC · GOOGLE CIVIC API & CENSUS GEOCODER

screens.name: Official Profile & Voting Record
screens.journey_name: J3 — Follow a Bill to the President's Desk
screens.description: Comprehensive elected official dossier: party affiliation glyph, district vector map, committee chairmanships/assignments, sponsored legislation portfolio, 100-vote history heatmap, party-unity dial gauge, and campaign fundraising sparkline.
screens.must_show: Party, district map, committee seats, sponsored bills, vote history heatmap, party-unity gauge, fundraising sparkline.
screens.sample_data: Sen. Elena Vance [D-MI] · Party Unity: 92% · Committees: Commerce, Science & Transportation · Sponsored: 14 bills (3 enacted) · Raised: $14.2M.

screens.name: Compare Officials (Vote Agreement Matrix)
screens.description: Multi-official head-to-head comparison: 2 to 4 legislators side by side, pairwise vote agreement percentage matrix, key divergent roll-calls, committee overlaps, and campaign donor industry breakdown.
screens.must_show: 2–4 side-by-side with vote agreement matrix.
screens.sample_data: Sen. Elena Vance [D-MI] vs Sen. Robert Sterling [R-OH]: 64% Overall Agreement, 88% Agreement on Infrastructure, Diverged on Tax Reconciliation.

screens.name: Finviz-Style Screener Builder
screens.description: Multi-entity Finviz-style parametric query builder: entity selector (Bills, Officials, Cases, Districts, Races, Rules), filter chips, numeric range sliders (cosponsors >25, bipartisan index >0.70, days stalled >60), column picker, and 4 quick presets.
screens.must_show: Entity selector, filter chips, numeric sliders, column picker, presets ('Bipartisan bills moving fast', 'Stalled appropriations', 'Close House races', 'Votes against party').
screens.sample_data: Entity: Bills · Preset: 'Bipartisan bills moving fast' · Filters: Cosponsors >= 30, BPI >= 0.75, Stage: Reported or Floor.

screens.name: Screener Results Table
screens.description: Dense tabular output of active query: sortable columns, inline progress sparklines, multi-row selection, CSV/JSON export trigger, and 'Open on Map' action.
screens.must_show: Dense table with sparklines, sort, export, 'open on map'.
screens.sample_data: 18 bills matched query: H.R. 4821 (#1 rank, 48 cosponsors, BPI 0.88), S. 2104 (#2 rank), H.R. 3110 (#3 rank) · Export button ready.

screens.name: Saved Screens & Watchlists
screens.description: User dashboard of saved queries and entity watchlists: change counters since last session, trigger frequency, active alert toggles, and shared screen links.
screens.must_show: Watchlists with change counts since last visit.
screens.sample_data: 4 Saved Screens: 'Bipartisan Fast-Track' (+3 new items), 'Approps Watch' (+1 item), 'Key 2026 Senate Races' (no changes), 'SCOTUS IP Cases'.

screens.name: Alert Rule Builder (IF/THEN)
screens.description: Rule composer for automated alerting: IF [Entity = Appropriations] AND [Days to Lapse <= 1] AND [CR Status = None] THEN [Dispatch Critical Push Notification], with historical 30-day simulated trigger backtest.
screens.must_show: IF/THEN rule composer, preview of last 30 days of triggers.
screens.sample_data: Rule: 'Notify me when appropriations funding passes' · IF [Bill Type = Appropriations] AND [Action = Signed by President] THEN [Push Alert] · Backtest: 2 triggers in 30d.
